List the available metrics

Source: R/registry.R
npc_metrics.Rd

The metric registry: every metric npc_compute_metrics() and npc_build_metrics() can produce, which universes of organizations it is valid for, and whether it needs financial data.

Usage

npc_metrics(universe = NULL)

Arguments

universe

Optional universe ("filers", "registered" or "grassroots") to list only the metrics valid for it.

Value

A data frame with id, family, financial (needs Form 990 or 990-EZ financial data), by_resource (depends on the resource column), universes and description.

Details

Financial metrics are limited to filers: organizations that file the Form 990-N postcard or file nothing do not report revenue, expenses or assets.

Examples

npc_metrics()
#>                        id      family financial by_resource

#> 2          DENSITY_PCTL_N       scale     FALSE       FALSE
#> 3              MEDIAN_AGE         age     FALSE       FALSE
